mapper.insert: INSERT INTO platform_im_channel_config (provider, purpose, enabled, route_version, app_key, credential_ref, robot_code, base_url, creator_id, modifier_id, is_deleted) VALUES (#{provider}, #{purpose}, #{enabled}, #{routeVersion}, #{appKey}, #{credentialRef}, #{robotCode}, #{baseUrl}, #{creatorId}, #{modifierId}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), enabled = VALUES(enabled), route_version = VALUES(route_version), app_key = VALUES(app_key), credential_ref = COALESCE(NULLIF(VALUES(credential_ref), ''), credential_ref), robot_code = VALUES(robot_code), base_url = VALUES(base_url), modifier_id = VALUES(modifier_id), is_deleted = 0, version = version + 1
